method: Same stored synthetic requests for 12 before/after conditions; five additional evidence/workflow checks. One output per condition is not a statistical quality benchmark.

cases.label: humor: same balanced brief
cases.assessment: The comic contradiction is explicit and grounded. Handoff-as-hero is clearer as a direction, but still needs a more distinctive expression and review of the relay implication.

cases.label: culture: same balanced brief
cases.assessment: Courtesy and recognition establish a social meaning beyond listing devices. The general courtesy language still needs campaign-specific creative judgment.

cases.label: audience: same balanced brief
cases.assessment: The revised line centers an adult, but next-turn language and the attached brand-staging instruction remain weaker points for human review.

cases.label: market: same balanced brief
cases.assessment: The final refinement names an evaluation criterion in the line itself, replacing the initial scene-only response. It proposes a use-based frame without competitive superiority.

cases.label: brand: same balanced brief
cases.assessment: Names the supplied brand principle and hierarchy. Screen-to-screen choreography remains close to the source Spark and should be reviewed for originality and one-at-a-time implications.

cases.label: humor: Experimental
cases.assessment: The surprise-guests metaphor is more playful than the balanced response. Test clarity and whether making introductions overstates the functional product role.

cases.label: market: Controls + steering
cases.assessment: Calendar steering now supports an explicit evaluation criterion rather than simply narrating a scene. Figurative connection language still needs reviewer judgment.

cases.label: Sparks: Initial household exploration
cases.assessment: Premise/Grounding/Validate makes comparison practical. Everyone’s Real Task, Specs Into Stories and Rooms Change Jobs still overlap in showing product through daily activity; the prompt does not guarantee six semantically unique ideas.

cases.label: Sparks: Fresh alternatives without steering
cases.assessment: Self-inclusion, household etiquette and recognition add different motives. Some premises still resemble the stored previous set; wording-level checks cannot guarantee semantic novelty.

cases.label: Sparks: Calendar steering with varied territories
cases.assessment: Calendar steering produces questions about fairness, possibility, personal choice, translation, visibility and flexibility. Fairness and visibility are related and should be compared before selection.

cases.label: Sparks: Excluded RTB and missing research
cases.assessment: All six rationales preserve the excluded RTB. Review physical-space and fairness metaphors so they do not imply an unsupported product outcome.

cases.label: Sparks: Business context with qualified evidence
cases.assessment: The illustrative interview stays qualified as one example and business context is retained. Not a Household is more a framing constraint than a developed creative territory; Beside the Till and Respect the System overlap.

cases.label: RTB: preserve supplied proof
cases.assessment: Original proof remains exact and the proposed interpretation is separately unapproved. The chosen handoff framing is illustrative and unvalidated.

cases.label: RTB: excluded proof despite conflicting steering
cases.assessment: The conflicting fastest-guarantee steering does not replace the explicit exclusion. The application preserves a null adaptation and the rationale explains the conflict.

cases.label: Research: single illustrative interview
cases.assessment: The supplied interview is retained verbatim with scope. Questions specify decisions and sources remain unconnected; some metadata falls into broad performance categories and would benefit from editorial review.

cases.label: Synthesis: weighted choice, zero-weight claim excluded
cases.assessment: The rationale explains the 80/20 emphasis and excludes the zero-weight unsupported claim. The line is coherent, although the attached product explanation can still be tightened.

cases.label: Final brief: approved line and exact requirements
cases.assessment: Approved strategy, requested assets and channels are exact. Proposed interpretation is labeled and no added offer or deadline appears. Some approval and constraint repetitions come from the existing preservation layer.
